title: FHIR Questionnaire Wireframe Input
description: Which built Questionnaire to render and review, against which L2 wireframe, and where the drawings and the requests for feedback go.

questionnaire.description: Repository-relative path of ONE built Questionnaire JSON (`fsh-generated/resources/Questionnaire-<id>.json`), never FSH. Several Questionnaires are several runs, so each carries its own fidelity findings and review.

mode.description: `render`: wireframe and form view for review. `fidelity-check`: only the field-for-field check against `wireframe`. `wireframe-from-questionnaire`: draw an L2 wireframe from a Questionnaire that has none.

wireframe.description: Repository-relative path of the L2 wireframe HTML the Questionnaire was derived from (the chosen `wireframe-design-review` candidate), when one exists.

renderer.description: The form-view renderer. Only the vendored NLM LHC-Forms (owner, 2026-10-14).

assetDir.description: Repository-relative directory for the wireframes, captures and checks.

suggest.description: Offer ✍ suggest, in its Questionnaire mode, on the form view.

issueForm.description: The issue form change requests are opened with.

channels.description: Where the request for review goes: chosen by judgement, and more than one may be right (staging-review, the deep-link rule, point 5).

branch.description: The feature branch the renderings are committed on, so feature-staging publishes them.
